ai.import: Import keys from Dyktando for macOS
ai.import_hint: Copies the keys saved in the previous app once. macOS will ask for permission to access the keychain.
ai.import_none: No new keys found in Dyktando for macOS
ai.intro: A summary sends the transcript (text only, not the recording) to the selected provider. Keys are kept in the system password store (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Secret Service on Linux) and never end up in settings files.
ai.key_placeholder_set: •••••••• (type a new one to change; empty + Save removes it)
ai.key_saved_msg: Key saved in the system password store
ai.title: AI — meeting summaries
audio.hint: When the selected microphone is disconnected, the default one records — your choice is remembered.
audio.title: Audio
common.retranscribe_hint: Transcribe again with the selected model and language
dictation.history: Keep dictation history (text and recording, on this computer only) — in the Meetings window → Dictations
dictation.hud: Show a bubble with the recording status
dictation.language_hint: Parakeet always detects the language itself; this choice applies to Whisper and Canary (with “Automatic”, Canary assumes Polish). The meetings language is set separately in the Meetings tab.
dictation.model_hint: The model must be downloaded in the Models tab. Parakeet is the fastest, Whisper adds punctuation on its own.
dictation.paste_mode.auto: Paste when a text field has focus
dictation.paste_mode_hint: After pasting, the previous clipboard contents (text) are restored.
dictation.title: Dictation
dictations.confirm_delete: Delete this dictation together with its recording?
dictations.empty: Every dictation shows up here: text and recording. If something comes out wrong, you can transcribe it again with another model or in another language.
dictations.retention_note: recordings are deleted together with meeting recordings (settings), the text stays
dictations.title: Dictations
export.mic_title: Download the microphone recording (what you say) as WAV
export.mixed_title: Download the whole conversation (you and the participants in one file) as WAV
export.system_title: Download the participants' recording (app audio) as WAV
lang_check.canary_multi: Canary doesn't detect the language itself — choose one language or Whisper.
lang_check.canary_none: Canary doesn't detect the language itself — without a choice it transcribes as Polish. Choose a language or Whisper.
lang_check.parakeet: Parakeet detects the language itself — the language choice works with Whisper and Canary.
lang_check.whisper_multi: Each utterance will be transcribed in whichever of the selected languages it is in.
lang_picker.foot: Select several if the conversation was in more than one language.
lang_picker.title: Conversation languages: {languages} — if the transcription is poor, pick them and transcribe again
meeting.add_key: Add an API key in Settings → AI
meeting.confirm_delete: Delete this meeting together with its recording, transcript and summaries?
meeting.gaps: Gaps in the recording (audio dropped out and was resumed):
meeting.live_note: Live — temporary text, without speaker recognition. The full transcript is created after the recording ends.
meeting.no_summary: No summary. Choose a provider and click “Summarize” — the transcript will be sent to the selected AI provider.
meetings.dictations_hint: Every dictation lands here (text and recording). You can turn this off in Settings → Dictation.
meetings.empty: Record meetings in Meet, Zoom or Teams: Dyktando X saves your microphone and the other participants' voices, transcribes them locally and — if you want — summarizes them with AI.
meetings.empty_list: No recordings. Click “Record meeting”, use the shortcut from settings, or import a recording file.
meetings.import_title: A file with a conversation recording (MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, Opus…) — it will be transcribed like a meeting
meetings_settings.auto_summarize: Then summarize with the default AI provider (AI tab)
meetings_settings.consent_reminder: When recording starts, remind me to inform the other participants
meetings_settings.diagnostics_hint: When part of a recording is missing, the log records when and why the audio dropped out.
meetings_settings.engine_hint: One hour of recording: Parakeet about 5 min, Whisper turbo about 12 min (Mac with Apple Silicon; longer on other computers). Whisper turbo makes noticeably fewer mistakes in Polish conversations and handles names and English terms better — that's why it's the default. A missing model is downloaded automatically on the first transcription.
meetings_settings.intro: Records two tracks: your microphone and app audio (the other participants in Meet, Zoom, Teams). Audio and transcripts stay on your computer; only the transcript is sent to the AI provider — and only when you ask for a summary.
meetings_settings.language_hint: Independent of the dictation language. Applies to Whisper and Canary — transcription after recording, live and of imported files; Parakeet always detects the language itself. For single-language conversations it's better to pick the language explicitly than “Automatic”.
meetings_settings.linux_hint: App audio is recorded from the default output's monitor (PulseAudio/PipeWire, the parec program from the pulseaudio-utils package).
meetings_settings.live_engine_hint: Speed matters live — Parakeet is best. After recording, the model selected above transcribes everything again.
meetings_settings.live_transcription: Transcribe live while recording (draft text every ~1.5 s)
meetings_settings.live_window: While recording, show a small always-on-top window with a timer, audio levels and live text
meetings_settings.macos_hint: macOS 14.4+: on the first recording the system asks for “System Audio Recording”. If the other participants can't be heard in the recording, enable Dyktando X in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording.
meetings_settings.retention_hint: Applies only to meetings that are already transcribed — the transcript and summaries stay.
meetings_settings.title: Meetings
meetings_settings.translate_hint: Translated by Canary 1B v2 (must be downloaded) — between English and the other languages, e.g. Polish → English or English → Polish. The source language is the “Meetings language” above. Each utterance is decoded twice, so the text appears later than without translation.
meetings_settings.vocabulary_hint: Names, terms and people that come up in conversations and dictation — Whisper will get them right more often. Separate them with commas, spelled the way you expect. Parakeet and Canary don't support the vocabulary.
meetings_settings.vocabulary_placeholder: e.g. NPaw, Hisense, Tizen, CI/CD, Apple TV, Claudius, Boris
meetings_settings.windows_hint: App audio requires Windows 11 or Windows 10 (build 20348+).
models.hint: Models run locally — recordings never leave your computer.
models.title: Models
prompt.body: Record it in Dyktando X? Remember to let the other participants know.
prompt.title: Meeting detected in {app}
shortcuts.altgr_hint: Right Alt is AltGr (used for accented characters), so it isn't available.
shortcuts.linux_hint: On Linux, shortcuts read the keyboard from /dev/input (works on Wayland too). If they don't respond, see the System tab.
shortcuts.modifier_hint: Pressing another key meanwhile (e.g. {example}) cancels the recording — shortcuts with this key keep working.
shortcuts.push_to_talk_hint: Records while you hold the key; when you release it, the text goes to the active window.
shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
system.accessibility_hint: Needed for global shortcuts and pasting (⌘V). Without it, text only goes to the clipboard. After granting it, click “Check again”.
system.microphone_macos: macOS asks for permission on the first recording. If dictation reports “digital silence”, enable Dyktando X in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
system.microphone_windows: Settings → Privacy → Microphone → “Let desktop apps access your microphone” must be turned on.
system.paste_wayland: Pasting tries, in order: wtype (Sway, Hyprland), dotool, ydotool. On GNOME and KDE install dotool or ydotool (they need access to /dev/uinput); without them the text stays in the clipboard.
system.title: Permissions and system
system.udev_hint: Shortcuts read the keyboard from /dev/input. Add a udev rule once (takes effect immediately, no need to log out):
system.ui_language_hint: Language of the app's windows and menus. The dictation and meetings languages are set separately.
update.installing: Downloading and installing — the app will restart by itself.
update.title: Updates
